plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero.
Exit QQQ to free up capital and reduce broad index concentration.
Trim SPY to 20% to address concentration and sector limits.
Reduce QQQI to 15% to lower income exposure.

conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration risk, aiming for lower drawdowns. Expect slower growth due to reduced risk.

balanced.read: This balanced approach targets about 2.5% monthly return by reducing leverage and concentration while adding a defensive sector. It aims for risk-first growth, balancing potential upside with controlled drawdowns. Leverage remains low.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly return by increasing leverage and concentrating in high-scoring tech names, including leveraged ETFs. Expect higher potential gains but also significantly larger drawdowns and amplified risk due to leverage and daily rebalancing of leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is crucial.
